record.title: Pollen imu_to_dxl v2 — LSM6DSV16X on a Dynamixel-Protocol-2 slave board, bus ID 200, riding the servo bus (GND, VDD, DATA)

requires.name: GND
requires.cite: part:xl330-m288-t connector.pinout — the same 3-pin bus the board plugs into (imu.rs:3-4 'rides the Dynamixel bus')

requires.name: VDD
requires.quote: rides the Dynamixel bus; fetched in the same sync_read as the servos, listed first
requires.cite: docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §4.1 (imu.rs:3-4; bus.rs:92). The board's input band and its regulator are CANNOT DETERMINE — MCU, transceiver, schematic, firmware are not in the repository (docs §4.1 last row).
requires.current_from_basis: THE CHIP ONLY (0.65 mA, part:lsm6dsv16x Table 4). The board's MCU and transceiver draw are unpublished, so the board total is CANNOT DETERMINE; this figure is a floor, not the board.

requires.name: DATA
requires.cite: part:xl330-m288-t logic.cite — the bus it shares

uncertainties: Connector count on the board is CANNOT DETERMINE. It matters: an XL330 has exactly two bus connectors, so a linear daisy chain can only branch at a device with three or more — the wiring lane puts the head/left-leg/right-leg branch at this board and says so.
MCU, transceiver, schematic, firmware: not in the repository (docs §4.1).
record.note: The control IMU, on the bus as device ID 200. Location: MJCF `imu` site on trunk_base at world (-21, 0, 105.3) mm (docs §4.1).
record.written: 2026-09-02, wiring lane (GOAL.md rung 5). Every figure names the document it came from; a figure with no document is null and says so.
